items.q: What does Untangle's manager agent do?
items.a: It **never writes code**—it pulls tickets and runs **~20 builder agents**.

items.q: How do you make sure the manager keeps up?
items.a: A **deterministic automation** makes it read every child session **every ~15 minutes**.

items.q: How many review loops does a builder get?
items.a: **Three reviews max**, then bugs bubble up to the manager and the human.

items.q: What proof ships with every feature?
items.a: A **recorded video** of the feature passing tests.

items.q: Which step should a human never skip?
items.a: **Actually watching the video** on a laptop before saying ship it.

items.q: Why skip early calls with candidates?
items.a: Likeability is **noise**; the only signal is **can they operate an agent**.
A **~45-minute screen recording** shipping a PR on an app they maintain.

items.q: What happens to the top five?
items.a: A **paid 16-hour project** to get a real PR merge-ready, then a final call.
